name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.29.1: Keep Bluetooth and animated UI updates responsive.
changelog.v2.29.0: Add the selection control and the segmented button; Do not reserve the plain row's gutter twice, or clamp an unknown choice.
changelog.v2.28.0: Count list windows in steps, not items.
changelog.v2.27.0: Give cards three weights and a verb, and make Status act; Keep the focus ring out of card layout, and the Status verbs append-only.
changelog.v2.26.1: Keep BLE sync responsive and cache UI rendering work; Initialize owned state before publishing or shutdown.
